overview: The committee discussed Department of Public Works staffing and capital plans following the passage of the Question 7 override, as well as a proposed volunteer tree planting program. No formal legislative votes were taken beyond procedural adjournment.

items.title: Resolution to Receive an Update on Roads (Paper 24-492)
items.summary: DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern and City Engineer Owen Wartella outlined plans to allocate $500,000 from the override to add three highway division staff and purchase equipment to bring spot road and sidewalk repairs in-house, freeing capital funds for larger resurfacing projects.

items.title: Resolution to Establish a Volunteer Tree Planting Program (Paper 24-493)
items.summary: The committee discussed creating a volunteer tree planting initiative to offset annual canopy loss, with DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern noting the key prerequisite would be funding a volunteer coordinator position or partnering with outside organizations.
